args.command: echo '=== outputs before ==='; DISPLAY=:0 xrandr --query 2>&1 || true; OUT=$(DISPLAY=:0 xrandr --query 2>/dev/null | awk '/ connected/{print $1; exit}'); echo "OUTPUT=$OUT"; if [ -z "$OUT" ]; then echo 'NO_CONNECTED_OUTPUT'; exit 1; fi; DISPLAY=:0 xrandr --output "$OUT" --rotate inverted; sleep 1; echo '=== after ==='; DISPLAY=:0 xrandr --query | grep ' connected' | head -5; echo 'DISPLAY_ROTATION=180'; chvt 3 2>/dev/null || true

meta.summary: Rotate Mini desktop display 180 degrees for upside-down monitor
